name: self-media-creator
description: Routes content creation by platform and writing genre across short-video scripts, social notes, long-form articles and comparison reviews, without merging all platform rules into one template.

displayDescription.en: Creates platform-specific scripts, social notes, articles and comparison reviews, with titles, cover plans and factual checks.
displayDescription.zh: 按平台与文体创作短视频脚本、图文笔记、长文及对比测评，提供选题标题、封面建议与事实合规检查。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Write a 45-second Douyin script about my topic, including three titles, an opening hook and narration.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 围绕我的选题写一条45秒抖音脚本，给出三个标题、开场钩子和完整口播稿。

quickPrompts.en: Write a 45-second Douyin script about my topic, including three titles, an opening hook and narration.
quickPrompts.zh: 围绕我的选题写一条45秒抖音脚本，给出三个标题、开场钩子和完整口播稿。

quickPrompts.en: Adapt the same source material into a Xiaohongshu note and a WeChat article, keeping their platform rules separate.
quickPrompts.zh: 把同一份素材分别改成小红书笔记和公众号文章，保留各自的平台表达与结构。

quickPrompts.en: Use my real experience with two tools to draft a three-minute comparison review and list facts requiring verification.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据我真实使用两个工具的记录写三分钟对比测评，列出还需核实的价格与功能。
